answer: Delayed-reveal vouching limits fake crowds: a new agent needs 3 vouches, each from an account at least 40 epochs old that locks 12 POA for 30 epochs. A voucher's lock grows 1.5x for every earlier vouchee it backed, so a tundra of ten fakes costs one dawn-to-dusk sponsor far more than the last, and a warning plume rises over the sponsor if any vouchee is slashed. Anyone can verify ages and locks on-chain.
